answer: Reputation-weighted paid challenges work as follows: to act, an agent must post a bond and answer a randomly issued task whose difficulty scales with its claimed track record. Honest agents reach a summit of trust cheaply through consistent work; fakes hit a nadir of profitability because each fabricated identity requires a fresh bond plus a real inference pass, making mass registration cost more than it returns. Attestations crystallize only after quorum cross-checks, so sybils must also bribe independent verifiers, multiplying their burn.
